en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad who said, ‘Is’haq Bin Ibrahim Al Deynouwary narrated to me, from Umar Bin Azhir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>,

said, ‘A man asked him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> about Al-Qaim<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘Can one greet upon him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> as ‘Amir Al-Momineen’?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘No, that is a name which Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Named Amir Al-Momineen<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> with. No one has been named with it before him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, nor would anyone be named with it after him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> except for ‘كَافِرٌ’ an Infidel’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>! How should one greet upon him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘They should be saying, ‘The greetings be upon you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, O Remaining one of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! (يَا بَقِيَّةَ اللَّهِ)’.
Then heasws recited [11:86] The Remaining one of Allah is better for you if you are Believers’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad who has said that Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Daynuri narrated to me from ‘Umar ibn Zahir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.).

He has said that a man asked, “Is al-Qa’im (the one who will rise with Divine Authority) is offered the Islamic greeting as the commander of the faithful?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “No, because that is the name that Allah had given to Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.). Allah had not given this name to anyone before him. No one will be called with this name except an unbeliever.” I then said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, what form of Islamic greeting would be offered to him?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “They will say, “Peace be up on you, O Baqiyya Allah (Allah’s reserved power to establish His authority on earth).

He then recited, “If you are true believers then know that the profit which God has left for you is better for you (than what you may gain through deceitful ways). I am not responsible for your deeds.” [11:86]
